raw_segments.text: Well, I said, and you would agree, would you not?
That what has been said about the state and the government is not a mere dream, and although
difficult not impossible, but only possible in the way which has been supposed.
That is to say, when the true philosopher-kings are born in a state, one or more of them,
despising the honors of this present world which they deem mean and worthless, esteeming
above all things right and the honor that springs from right, and regarding justice
as the greatest and most necessary of all things, whose ministers they are, and whose
principles will be exalted by them when they set in order their own city.
